topPRs.title: Add AIONICO token for World Chain
topPRs.author: Eldioscripto-arch
topPRs.body:
Add AIONICO token (0x89C2A3fC33bc7cc1140e6408e050De230D5cC0Dc) on World Chain (chain ID 480). Native token of the Trust Circle protocol by AIONICA Security Lab.

**Description**

Adding AIONICO, the native token of the Trust Circle protocol — a digital ROSCA (Rotating Savings and Credit Association) deployed on World Chain. Token contract: 0x89C2A3fC33bc7cc1140e6408e050De230D5cC0Dc

**Tests**

Token contract is deployed and verified on World Chain mainnet (chain ID 480).

**Additional context**

- Protocol website: https://trust-circle-five.vercel.app
- Token decimals: 18
- Total supply: 100,000,000 AIONICO
